text: Cloud computing is an on-demand network model that provides shared access to configurable computing resources including servers, storage, and software.
Soil moisture sensors utilize dielectric properties to measure volumetric water content, providing analog voltage proportional to soil capacitance.
Microservices architecture decomposes monolithic applications into loosely coupled, independently deployable services communicating over lightweight APIs.
In precision agriculture, the normalized difference vegetation index (NDVI) assesses crop health by comparing near-infrared reflectance to visible red absorption.
Virtual machine monitors (hypervisors) arbitrate access to underlying physical hardware, allocating vCPUs, memory pages, and I/O channels to guest OS instances.
The Internet of Things integrates physical sensing nodes with cloud analytics through low-power wireless communication protocols such as LoRaWAN.
Deadlock detection in operating systems requires tracking resource allocation graphs and searching for cycles using Tarjan's strongly connected components algorithm.
Edge computing offloads computationally intensive processing from central cloud datacenters to gateways situated near field sensor clusters.
Containerization packages application code together with its runtime dependencies and libraries, sharing the host OS kernel through Linux cgroups and namespaces.
Actuators in automated irrigation open solenoid valves when soil moisture drops below calibrated plant water requirement thresholds.
Convolutional neural networks extract local spatial features from agricultural imagery by sliding parameterized kernel matrices across pixel arrays.
Elasticity in cloud infrastructure allows compute capacity to automatically scale up or down based on incoming request velocity and CPU saturation metrics.
Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) deploy battery-operated nodes communicating through multi-hop mesh routing algorithms like RPL.
Event-driven architecture decouples event producers from consumers using durable message brokers such as Apache Kafka or RabbitMQ.
Smart greenhouse control balances photosynthetic active radiation, relative humidity, and CO2 enrichment to optimize vegetable biomass yield.
Relational databases maintain ACID guarantees using write-ahead logging (WAL) and strict two-phase locking protocols.
